ledger_definitions.out_N: Cumulative surviving photons per H transferred below the H I cross-section cutoff when fixed eta nodes cross E=13.6 eV.
ledger_definitions.out_E: 13.6 eV times each transferred stock, in erg/H.
ledger_definitions.escape_E: Case-A capture/recombination and other emitted cooling radiation from the gas; distinct from outflow across the tracked photon lower boundary.
ledger_definitions.source_leave: Each node stops being sourced at E=13.7 eV, ln(13.7/13.6)=0.007326040092... in ln(a) before its lower-boundary exit.

maximum_individual_exiting_stock_bounds.reason: Nonnegative transfer stocks; group sum/count is a lower bound on the maximum member, and group sum is an upper bound. Final-node snapshots erase exited stock, so the exact global maximum is not reconstructed.

heuristic_uniform_resolution.assumption: Holding local continuum density and allowance fixed, equal-weight node stock scales inversely with panels. This is an event-amplitude diagnostic, not a proof of required resolution at the prescribed 273 phases.

cost_scenario.interpretation: One empirical doubling; scenario only, no runtime forecast or feasibility guarantee.

causal_limits: All outflow changes coincide with lower-HI cutoff events; the stock-transfer staircase is the direct ledger mechanism. Source-edge quadrature and coupled chemistry determine the stock reaching that boundary, so their indirect contribution is not isolated by these two runs. No pure source-vs-boundary causal fraction is claimed.
recommended_next_decision: Hold native and brute uniform refinement. Review a conservation-consistent continuous boundary flux or event-local partial-panel integration experiment under unchanged physical thresholds, source normalization and all original criteria. A 256-panel solve, if separately authorized, would be a diagnostic convergence/cost probe only, not a plausible certificate or selected native grid.
